Privacy Policy

Effective date: 3 October 2026

Daam Kingdom is operated by HostReady LLC. This policy explains how information is handled when you use the Daam Kingdom website or mobile application.

Information we process
Username: the display name you enter for a match.
Game information: room code, board position, messages selected from the preset list, match status and reconnection token.
Technical information: hosting and security providers may process IP address, device type, browser information and request logs to operate and protect the service.
How information is used

Information is used only to create multiplayer rooms, synchronize matches, reconnect players, operate the Daam Bot, prevent abuse and maintain service reliability. Daam Kingdom does not sell personal information, display third-party advertising or use game information for behavioural advertising.

Storage and retention

Inactive room records are automatically removed after approximately 24 hours. Security and infrastructure logs may be retained for a limited period by our hosting providers. Do not use your legal name as your game username if you prefer to remain anonymous.

Sharing

Information is processed by service providers needed to host and secure the game. It is not shared with data brokers or advertisers. Information may be disclosed when required by applicable law.

Children

The game does not request a date of birth, contact list, precise location, photographs or payment information. Parents or guardians should supervise children and help them choose a non-identifying username.

Your choices

You may stop using the game at any time. Because no user account is created, room information cannot normally be linked back to you after the room expires. For a privacy question or deletion request concerning an active room, contact us with the room code.

Daam Kingdom Support
Quick help
Tap Create Room, then share the six-character code with another player.
If nobody joins within 10 seconds, Daam Bot joins automatically.
Tap one of your pieces, then tap a glowing destination square.
Captures are compulsory. Continue with the same piece when another jump is available.
Music begins after Create Room or Join Room is tapped. Use the music and sound buttons to control audio.
If a connection drops, return within 60 seconds to resume the match.
Contact support

When reporting a problem, include your device model, operating-system version and room code. Do not send passwords or payment information.
